import main, random, json
from itertools import combinations, product

def brute(model):
    K=model['K']; atoms=model['atoms']; fieldmap=model['fieldmap']; B=model['B']; S=model['S']; W=model['W']
    tc=main.build_contexts(model['train'],K)
    pc=main.build_contexts(model['probes'],K)
    qc=main.build_contexts(model['queries'],K)
    sources=model['train_sources']
    A=len(atoms)
    # atom truth
    tt=[[main.eval_atom(a,c['values'],fieldmap) for a in atoms] for c in tc]
    pt=[[main.eval_atom(a,c['values'],fieldmap) for a in atoms] for c in pc]
    qt=[[main.eval_atom(a,c['values'],fieldmap) for a in atoms] for c in qc]
    def lv(t,a,neg): return (not t[a]) if neg else t[a]
    classes={}
    members=[]
    if len(sources)==0 or len(pc)==0:
        pass
    else:
      for w in range(1,B+1):
        if w>A: break
        for combo in combinations(range(A),w):
            for signs in product([False,True],repeat=w):
                lits=list(zip(combo,signs))
                # cond2
                ok=True
                for (a,neg) in lits:
                    for s in sources:
                        cnt=sum(1 for ci,c in enumerate(tc) if c['source']==s and lv(tt[ci],a,neg))
                        if cnt<S: ok=False;break
                    if not ok:break
                if not ok:continue
                # cond3
                for ci in range(len(tc)):
                    if not any(lv(tt[ci],a,neg) for (a,neg) in lits):
                        ok=False;break
                if not ok:continue
                # cond5
                probeoff=False
                sig=0
                for pi in range(len(pc)):
                    v=any(lv(pt[pi],a,neg) for (a,neg) in lits)
                    if v: sig|=1<<pi
                    else: probeoff=True
                if not probeoff:continue
                # cond4
                for i,(a,neg) in enumerate(lits):
                    for s in sources:
                        cnt=0
                        for ci,c in enumerate(tc):
                            if c['source']!=s: continue
                            if lv(tt[ci],a,neg) and all(not lv(tt[ci],a2,n2) for j,(a2,n2) in enumerate(lits) if j!=i):
                                cnt+=1
                        if cnt<W: ok=False;break
                    if not ok:break
                if not ok:continue
                classes.setdefault(sig,[]).append(lits)
    # queries
    out=[]
    for qi in range(len(qc)):
        M=0;Y=0
        for sig,mem in classes.items():
            falses=[]
            for lits in mem:
                v=any(lv(qt[qi],a,neg) for (a,neg) in lits)
                falses.append(not v)
            if all(falses): M+=1
            if any(falses): Y+=1
        out.append((M,Y))
    return {sig:len(v) for sig,v in classes.items()}, out

def gen(seed):
    r=random.Random(seed)
    nf=r.randint(1,3)
    schema=[]
    for i in range(nf):
        schema.append({"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"})
    A=r.randint(0,3)
    K=r.randint(1,3)
    atoms=[]
    for _ in range(A):
        a=r.randrange(nf)
        # sometimes quantifier
        if r.random()<0.3 and K>1:
            lo=r.randrange(K); hi=r.randint(lo,K-1)
            atoms.append({"quantifier":r.choice(["any","all"]),"from":lo,"to":hi,"predicate":{"cmp":r.choice(["eq","ne"]),"left":{"field":"f%d"%a,"at":"$"},"right":{"const":r.choice([True,False]),"type":"FLAG"}}})
        else:
            atoms.append({"cmp":r.choice(["eq","ne"]),"left":{"field":"f%d"%a,"at":r.randrange(K)},"right":{"const":r.choice([True,False]),"type":"FLAG"}})
    def traces(n,prefix):
        arr=[]
        for i in range(n):
            nr=r.randint(0,4)
            ts=r.sample(range(100),nr)
            rows=[{"t":ts[j],"values":[r.choice([True,False]) for _ in range(nf)]} for j in range(nr)]
            arr.append({"id":prefix+str(i),"source":r.choice(["s1","s2"]),"rows":rows})
        return arr
    d={"version":1,"schema":schema,"window":K,"atoms":atoms,
       "policy":{"max_width":r.randint(1,4),"min_support":r.randint(1,2),"min_witness":r.randint(1,2)},
       "train":traces(r.randint(0,3),"tr"),"probes":traces(r.randint(0,2),"pr"),"queries":traces(r.randint(0,2),"qu")}
    return d

bad=0
for seed in range(500):
    d=gen(seed)
    try:
        model=main.validate_request(d)
        resp=main.mine(model)
    except main.SchemaError:
        continue
    exp,bq=brute(model)
    got={}
    for c in resp['classes']:
        got[int(c['signature'],16)]=c['members']
    gq=[(q['must'],q['may']) for q in resp['queries']]
    if got!=exp or gq!=bq:
        bad+=1
        print('MISMATCH seed',seed)
        print('got',got,'exp',exp)
        print('gq',gq,'bq',bq)
        print(json.dumps(d))
        if bad>3: break
print('done bad=',bad)
